_comment: D5.3 STREAM 4 of 4 — the seam's own liveness: the stream that vouches for the other streams' plumbing. It names FLOOR-SEAM, a control the harness deliberately does NOT ship, because a control id invented by the harness and owned by nobody is the mapping-to-nothing scripts/adapter-check.mjs refuses. So this declaration only mounts in a repository whose catalog carries FLOOR-SEAM — this example's own, and any adopter who has added and owns it. It ships DECLARED, NOT ACTIVE and stays that way: nobody has probed a seam, and a seam-liveness observation nobody made is the exact overstatement this gate exists to refuse.
capability: The collaboration surface is reachable, is the workspace the repository thinks it is, and was observed refusing a bypass of the seam itself

evidence._max_age_days: The tightest window in the example. A seam's freshness target is measured in minutes; a day is already generous, and the 7-day default would let a dead surface read as live for a sprint.
